paite: Himahleh Solomon in Pharaoh tanu ban ah namdang numei tampi a-it hi. Amau Moabte, Ammonte, Edomte, Zidonte leh Hitte ahi uh.
heading: Pathian A Pan Solomon Akiheimang

paite: Huai namte tungtang thu TOUPA'N Israel suante kiang ah, "Amau toh na kitentuah het louh ding uh ahi. Na kitentuah uleh apathiante uh lam a na lungtang uh hon ngasak ngeingei ding uh ahi," chi a na hilh khit tak namte ahi uh. Hinapi in Solomon in amau it in alen tinten hi.
Huchi in zipi zasagih, kumpipa tanute anei a, mei zathum anei hi. Huai azite'n alungtang apikawisak uhi.
Hichi ahong hi a, Solomon ahong upat nung in, azite'n pathian dangte lam ah alungtang apikawisak uhi. Huchi in apa David lungtang bang in TOUPA a Pathian lam ah alungtang ahoihkimta kei hi.
heading: Solomon Melmate

paite: Solomon in Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth leh Ammonte pathian kihhuai mahmah Milkom azuita hi.
Huchi in Solomon in TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahihta a, apa David bang in TOUPA azui tettet kei hi.
Huchi in Solomon in Jerusalem chin a mual ah Moabte pathian kihhuai mahmah Khemosh a ding leh Ammon suante Pathian kihhuai mahmah Molek a ding in mun sang abawlta hi.
Huai mah bang in namdang azi tengteng apathiante uh kiang a kithoih a gimlim hal zelte a ding leng abawlsak hi.
Huchi in TOUPA Israelte' Pathian, akiang a nihvei kilak khinsa alungtang in alehngatsan ziak in, Solomon tung ah TOUPA ahehta hi.
Hiai thu, pathian dangte na zui ding ahi kei, chih thu a na pepa TOUPA thupiak lah azui kei hi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA'N Solomon kiang ah, "Hichibang in na omta a, ka thukhun leh ka dan thusehte zuih dia thu ka hon piak lah na zuita kei hi. Gam ka hon sut ngeingei dia, na sikha ka pe ding.
Himahleh na pa David ziak in na damsung tel in zaw ka hih tadih kei ding. Himahleh na tapa khut a pan gam pen ka hon sut ding hi.
Gam tengteng ka hon sut vek kei dia; himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh ka tel Jerusalem ziak in nam khat na tapa ka pe ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N Solomon melma ding in Edom mi, Hadad adingkhesakta a; amah Edom gam kumpipa suan ahi.
heading: Solomon Melmate

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Edom gam a David a-om lai a, amithahte uh vui ding a asepaih heutu Joab ahohtouh a, Edom mi pasal peuhmah ava thah khit nung in,
Joab leh Israel mi tengteng kha guktak Edom gam a pasal tengteng ahihlup khit masiah om uhi.
Hadad leh apa sikhate lak a Edom mi khenkhatte Aigupta gam ah atai ua; Hadad ahihleh naupang neu ahi lai hi.

Midian gam a pan apawt ua, Paran ahong tung uh. Paran a pan mite api ua, Aigupta gam, Aigupta gam kumpipa Pharaoh kiang atungsuk ua; ama'n inn ana pia a, nek dingte ana ngaihtuahsak a, gam leng ana pia hi.
Hadad tung ah Pharaoh mit atung mahmah a, huchi in ama zi sanggamnu, kumpinu Tahpenes sanggamnu azi ding in apia hi.
Tahpenes sanggamnu in tapa Genubath aneihsak a, Tahpenes in Pharaoh inn ah anawinek tawpna abawlsak hi. Pharaoh inn ah Pharaoh tapate lak ah Genubath a-omta hi.
Hadad in Aigupta gam a pan David apute kiang ah a-ihmuta chih leh sepaih heutu Joab leng asita chih ana zak in, Hadad in Pharaoh kiang ah, "Ka gam ua ka paitheihna ding in hon pawtsak ve," achi hi.

Huchi in Pharaoh in akiang ah, "Ka kiang a nå om in taksap bang na nei a? Ngai in, huchi a na gam ua pai nawn na tup maimah?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Bangmah nei lou e. Bang teng hileh hon paisak himhim in," achi hi.
Pathian in amelma ding in Eliadah tapa Rezon, atoupa Hadadezer, Zobah kumpipa a pan taimangsa leng adingsak nawn hi.
David in Zobah a mite athah lai in ama'n akiang ah mite akaikhawm a, sepaih heutu in ana pang hi. Damaskas ah ahoh ua, huai ah ateng ua, Damaskas ah kumpipa in atuta hi.
Hadad in buaina tut behlap in Solomon damsung teng Israelte melma ahi gige a; Israelte aho mahmah a, Siria gam tung ah vai ahawm hi.
Nebat tapa Jeroboam, Zered a Ephraim mi Solomon sikha mah, anu min Zeruah ahi a, meithai ahi, huai mi'n leng kumpipa tung ah akhut alik sam hi.
heading: Jeroboam Kiang A Pathian Thuchiam

paite: Kumpipa tung a akhut ahon likna san hichibang ahi: Solomon in Millo abawl a, apa David khua asiatna lailai abawlhoih hi.
Jeroboam ahihleh mihat leh hangsan ahi a; huchi in Solomon in huai tangval mithanuamtak ahi chih atheih ziak in Joseph inkote nasep tengteng tung ah heutu in abawl hi.
Huai lai in hichi ahong hi a, Jerusalem a pan Jeroboam apawtkhiak lai in Shiloh mi zawlnei Ahijah in lampi ah ana mu a; Ahijah in puan thak asilh a; amau gel kia in gamlak ah a-om uhi.
Ahijah in apuan thak silh ala a, nen sawm-le-nih in abotkek hi.
Jeroboam kiang ah, "Nen sawm la in," TOUPA, Israelte' Pathian in hichi in achi, "Ngai in, Solomon khut a pan lalgam ka sut dia, nam sawm nang ka hon pe ding.
Himahleh ka sikha David ziak leh Israel nam tengteng lak a ka tel khopi, Jerusalem ziak in nam khat anei ding;

amau hon paisan a, Zidonte pathiannu Ashtaroth, Moabte pathian Kemosh leh Ammonte pathian Milkom abiak ziak un leh ka mitmuh a thil hoih hih ding leh ka sehte leh ka vaihawmte zui dia apa David bang a ka lampite azuih louh ziak in.
"Gam pumpi in ahihleh ka sut kei dia; himahleh ka thupiakte leh ka dan thusehte zuipa, ka tel, ka sikha David ziak in adamsung in kumpipa in ka omsak lai ding.
Himahleh atapa khut a pan in lalgam ka sutkhe dia, nang ka hon pe ding, nam sawmte tan in leng.
Ka sikha David in ka min omna ding a ka tel khopi Jerusalem a ka ma a vak aneih gige theihna ding in nam khat bel atapa ka pe ding hi.
Nang ka hon sep ding a, na ut tengteng bang in vai na hawm dia, Israelte kumpipa na hi ding.

Huan hichi ahi ding a, thu ka hon piak peuhmah na pom a, ka lampite na zuih a, ka sikha David bang a ka dan thusehte leh ka thupiakte zui dia ka mitmuh a thil hoih na hihleh na kiang ah ka om dia, David a dia ka dinkipsak bang in inkuan kip ka hon dinkhiaksak dia, Israelte ka hon pe ding hi.
Huchi in David suan ka hihgim dia, himahleh tangtawn in zaw ahi kei ding," achi hi.
Huaiziak in Solomon in Jeroboam thah atum a, Jeroboam a ding a, Aigupta gam ah, Aigupta gam kumpipa Shishak kiang ah atai a, Solomon sih matan Aigupta gam ah a-omta hi.
Solomon tanchin dangte leh athilhih tengteng leh apilna Solomon thilhih gelhna bu ah atuang kei a hia?
heading: Solomon Sihna / (2 Kro 9.29-31)

paite: Solomon in Israel tengteng tung a Jerusalem a vai ahawm sung kum sawmli ahi.
Huchi in Solomon apute kiang ah a-ihmuta a, apa David khopi ah avui uh. Huchi in atapa Rehoboam asik in ahong lalta hi.
